<skill_content name="frontend-design">
# Skill: frontend-design

# Frontend Design

Approach this as the design lead at a small studio known for giving every client a visual identity that could not be mistaken for anyone else's. This client has already rejected proposals that felt templated, and is paying for a distinctive point of view: make deliberate, opinionated choices about palette, typography, and layout that are specific to this brief, and take one real aesthetic risk you can justify.

## Ground it in the subject

If the brief does not pin down what the product or subject is, pin it yourself before designing: name one concrete subject, its audience, and the page's single job, and state your choice. If there's any information in your memory about the human's preferences, context about what they're building, or designs you've made before – use that as a hint. The subject's own world, its materials, instruments, artifacts, and vernacular, is where distinctive choices come from. Build with the brief's real content and subject matter throughout.

## Design principles

For web designs, the hero is a thesis. Open with the most characteristic thing in the subject's world, in whatever form makes sense for it: a headline, an image, an animation, a live demo, an interactive moment. Be deliberate with your choice: a big number with a small label, supporting stats, and a gradient accent is the template answer, only use if that's truly the best option.

Typography carries the personality of the page. Pair the display and body faces deliberately, not the same families you would reach for on any other project, and set a clear type scale with intentional weights, widths, and spacing. Make the type treatment itself a memorable part of the design, not a neutral delivery vehicle for the content.

Structure is information. Structural devices, numbering, eyebrows, dividers, labels, should encode something true about the content, not decorate it. Many generic designs use numbered markers (01 / 02 / 03), but that's only appropriate if the content actually is a sequence - like a real process or a typed timeline where order carries information the reader needs. Question if choices like numbered markers actually make sense before incorporating them.

Leverage motion deliberately. Think about where and if animation can serve the subject: a page-load sequence, a scroll-triggered reveal, hover micro-interactions, ambient atmosphere. An orchestrated moment usually lands harder than scattered effects; choose what the direction calls for. However, sometimes less is more, and extra animation contributes to the feeling that the design is AI-generated.

Match complexity to the vision. Maximalist directions need elaborate execution; minimal directions need precision in spacing, type, and detail. Elegance is executing the chosen vision well.

Consider written content carefully. Often a design brief may not contain real content, and it's up to you to come up with copy. Copy can make a design feel as templated as the design itself. See the below section on writing for more guidance.

## Process: brainstorm, explore, plan, critique, build, critique again

For calibration: AI-generated design right now clusters around three looks: (1) a warm cream background (near #F4F1EA) with a high-contrast serif display and a terracotta accent; (2) a near-black background with a single bright acid-green or vermilion accent; (3) a broadsheet-style layout with hairline rules, zero border-radius, and dense newspaper-like columns. All three are legitimate for some briefs, but they are defaults rather than choices, and they appear regardless of subject. Where the brief pins down a visual direction, follow it exactly — the brief's own words always win, including when it asks for one of these looks. Where it leaves an axis free, don't spend that freedom on one of these defaults. Just like a human designer who's hired, there's often a careful balance between doing what you're good at and taking each project as a chance to experiment and learn.

Work in two passes. First, brainstorm a short design plan based on the human's design brief: create a compact token system with color, type, layout, and signature. Color: describe the palette as 4–6 named hex values. Type: the typefaces for 2+ roles (a characterful display face that's used with restraint, a complementary body face, and a utility face for captions or data if needed). Layout: a layout concept, using one-sentence prose descriptions and ASCII wireframes to ideate and compare. Signature: the single unique element this page will be remembered by that embodies the brief in an appropriate way.

Then review that plan against the brief before building: if any part of it reads like the generic default you would produce for any similar page (work through a similar prompt to see if you arrive somewhere similar) rather than a choice made for this specific brief — revise that part, say what you changed and why. Only after you've confirmed the relative uniqueness of your design plan should you start to write the code, following the revised plan exactly and deriving every color and type decision from it.

When writing the code, be careful of structuring your CSS selector specificities. It's easy to generate CSS classes that cancel each other out (especially with a type-based selector like .section and a element-based selector like .cta). This can happen often with paddings/margins between sections.

Try to do a lot of this planning and iteration in your thinking, and only show ideas to the user when you have higher confidence it'll delight them.

## Restraint and self-critique

Spend your boldness in one place. Let the signature element be the one memorable thing, keep everything around it quiet and disciplined, and cut any decoration that does not serve the brief. Not taking a risk can be a risk itself! Build to a quality floor without announcing it: responsive down to mobile, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion respected. Critique your own work as you build, taking screenshots if your environment supports it – a picture is worth 1000 tokens. Consider Chanel's advice: before leaving the house, take a look in the mirror and remove one accessory. Human creators have memory and always try to do something new, so if you have a space to quickly jot down notes about what you've tried, it can help you in future passes.

## More on writing in design

Words appear in a design for one reason: to make it easier to understand, and therefore easier to use. They are design material, not decoration. Bring the same intentionality to copy that you would bring to spacing and color. Before writing anything, ask what the design needs to say, and how it can best be said to help the person navigate the experience.

Write from the end user's side of the screen. Name things by what people control and recognize, never by how the system is built. A person manages notifications, not webhook config. Describe what something does in plain terms rather than selling it. Being specific is always better than being clever.

Use active voice as default. A control should say exactly what happens when it's used: "Save changes," not "Submit." An action keeps the same name through the whole flow, so the button that says "Publish" produces a toast that says "Published." The vocabulary of an interface is the signposting for someone navigating the product. Cohesion and consistency are how people learn their way around.

Treat failure and emptiness as moments for direction, not mood. Explain what went wrong and how to fix it, in the interface's voice rather than a person's. Errors don't apologize, and they are never vague about what happened. An empty screen is an invitation to act.

Keep the register conversational and tuned: plain verbs, sentence case, no filler, with tone matched to the brand and the audience. Let each element do exactly one job. A label labels, an example demonstrates, and nothing quietly does double duty.

6. `statistic` — 10K+ / 500+ / 95% dengan divider vertikal
7. `testimonial` — carousel 8 testimoni + panah + slider dots
8. `pricing` — 3 plan (Free $0, Basic $5 "Popular", Pro $15) + toggle Monthly/Annually
9. `about us` — teks + placeholder image besar
10. `galery` — grid 2 baris × 4 gambar
11. `faq` — accordion 6 item + CTA "Still have questions?"
12. `footer` — headline + link list + social + credits "© 2026 MentalZee"

**Design tokens:**
- Warna: `#FFFFFF` (teks), `#2A2826` (bg gelap/neutral Darker), `#5CB8A8` (soft teal accent/CTA), overlay `rgba(42,40,38,.5/.75)`, `#020704` (harga), `#FFCC00` (bintang)
- Tipografi: **Lora** (display/H1, SemiBold 600, 40–80px) + **Plus Jakarta Sans** (body, 300–700, 14–20px)
- Layout: width 1440px, padding 80px, container 1280px, radius 16px (kartu) / 24px (tombol), shadow-xs `0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05)`
- Ikon (lucide-style): list-plus, sprout, smile-plus, user-star, user-check, list-check, sparkles, leafy-green, gem, check, chevron-up/down, arrow-left/right/up-right, Facebook/Instagram/X/Youtube

## Rencana Implementasi Bertahap

**Fase 0 — Setup project**
- `create-next-app` (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) di `D:\test-vibecode\figma-final`
- Install `framer-motion` + `lucide-react`
- Setup font via `next/font/google` (Lora + Plus Jakarta Sans)
- Definisikan design tokens di `globals.css` (CSS variables) + Tailwind theme extension
- Download semua gambar Figma (bg section + kartu + galeri + avatar) via `figma_download_figma_images` ke `public/images/`
- Buat shared primitives: `Container`, `SectionTitle` (eyebrow + H1 + subtitle), `Button` (default/outline/ghost variant, size sm/lg)

**Fase 1 — Hero** (untuk review pertama)
- Hero: bg image + overlay, eyebrow tagline, display headline (dengan "Live Better" di-highlight), subtext, CTA pill "Start Your Journey" dengan ikon arrow, divider "Calm & Peaceful"
- Termasuk `navbar` floating di atas hero (satu viewport)
- Animasi: staggered fade-up pada load (eyebrow→headline→subtext→CTA), ambient slow zoom "breathing" pada bg image (signature element — ritme napas yang mendukung tema mental health), hover micro-interaction pada CTA

**Fase 2 — Header** ("A Safe Space") — reveal scroll + fade

**Fase 3 — Features** — 4 kartu, stagger reveal, hover lift + image scale

**Fase 4 — How It Works** — 4 step, ikon scale-in stagger, garis penghubung draw-on-scroll, tombol hover

**Fase 5 — Statistic** — count-up angka saat in-view

**Fase 6 — Testimonial** — carousel slide (AnimatePresence) + dots sync + auto-play optional

**Fase 7 — Pricing** — toggle Monthly/Annually dengan layout animasi, kartu "Popular" subtle glow pulse, hover lift

**Fase 8 — About Us** — parallax image reveal + text fade

**Fase 9 — Gallery** — stagger reveal + hover zoom

**Fase 10 — FAQ** — accordion dengan height auto animation (AnimatePresence), chevron rotate

**Fase 11 — Footer** — fade in, social hover, avatar stack

Setiap fase selesai saya hentikan untuk Anda review sebelum lanjut ke fase berikutnya.

**Catatan desain (frontend-design skill):** Desain Figma sudah "pin" arah visual — warm photographic overlay + soft teal accent + serif Lora — yang mirip cluster default "near-black + single accent" tapi dibedakan oleh overlay fotografik hangat & serif editorial yang pas untuk tema mental health. Saya akan ikuti Figma persis (brief's own words win). Signature element = ambient breathing pada hero bg.

1: ---
2: title: Font Optimization
3: description: Learn how to optimize fonts in Next.js
4: related:
5:   title: API Reference
6:   description: See the API Reference for the full feature set of Next.js Font
7:   links:
8:     - app/api-reference/components/font
9: ---
10: 
11: The [`next/font`](/docs/app/api-reference/components/font) module automatically optimizes your fonts and removes external network requests for improved privacy and performance.
12: 
13: It includes **built-in self-hosting** for any font file. This means you can optimally load web fonts with no layout shift.
14: 
15: <AppOnly>
16: 
17: To start using `next/font`, import it from [`next/font/local`](#local-fonts) or [`next/font/google`](#google-fonts), call it as a function with the appropriate options, and set the `className` of the element you want to apply the font to. For example:
18: 
19: ```tsx filename="app/layout.tsx" highlight={1,3-5,9} switcher
20: import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
21: 
22: const geist = Geist({
23:   subsets: ['latin'],
24: })
25: 
26: export default function Layout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
27:   return (
28:     <html lang="en" className={geist.className}>
29:       <body>{children}</body>
30:     </html>
31:   )
32: }
33: ```
34: 
35: ```jsx filename="app/layout.js" highlight={1,3-5,9} switcher
36: import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
37: 
38: const geist = Geist({
39:   subsets: ['latin'],
40: })
41: 
42: export default function Layout({ children }) {
43:   return (
44:     <html className={geist.className}>
45:       <body>{children}</body>
46:     </html>
47:   )
48: }
49: ```
50: 
51: Fonts are scoped to the component they're used in. To apply a font to your entire application, add it to the [Root Layout](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/layout#root-layout).
52: 
53: </AppOnly>
54: 
55: <PagesOnly>
56: 
57: To start using `next/font`, import it from [`next/font/local`](#local-fonts) or [`next/font/google`](#google-fonts), call it as a function with the appropriate options, and set the `className` of the element you want to apply the font to. For example, you can apply fonts globally in your [Custom App](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/custom-app) (`pages/_app`):
58: 
59: ```tsx filename="pages/_app.tsx" highlight={1,4-6,10} switcher
60: import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
61: import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'
62: 
63: const geist = Geist({
64:   subsets: ['latin'],
65: })
66: 
67: export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
68:   return (
69:     <main className={geist.className}>
70:       <Component {...pageProps} />
71:     </main>
72:   )
73: }
74: ```
75: 
76: ```jsx filename="pages/_app.js" highlight={1,3-5,9} switcher
77: import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
78: 
79: const geist = Geist({
80:   subsets: ['latin'],
81: })
82: 
83: export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
84:   return (
85:     <main className={geist.className}>
86:       <Component {...pageProps} />
87:     </main>
88:   )
89: }
90: ```
91: 
92: </PagesOnly>
93: 
94: ## Google fonts
95: 
96: You can automatically self-host any Google Font. Fonts are included as static assets and served from the same domain as your deployment, meaning no requests are sent to Google by the browser when the user visits your site.
97: 
98: To start using a Google Font, import your chosen font from `next/font/google`:
99: 
100: <AppOnly>
101: 
102: ```tsx filename="app/layout.tsx" switcher
103: import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
104: 
105: const geist = Geist({
106:   subsets: ['latin'],
107: })
108: 
109: export default function RootLayout({
110:   children,
111: }: {
112:   children: React.ReactNode
113: }) {
114:   return (
115:     <html lang="en" className={geist.className}>
116:       <body>{children}</body>
117:     </html>
118:   )
119: }
120: ```
121: 
122: ```jsx filename="app/layout.js" switcher
123: import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
124: 
125: const geist = Geist({
126:   subsets: ['latin'],
127: })
128: 
129: export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
130:   return (
131:     <html lang="en" className={geist.className}>
132:       <body>{children}</body>
133:     </html>
134:   )
135: }
136: ```
137: 
138: </AppOnly>
139: 
140: <PagesOnly>
141: 
142: ```tsx filename="pages/_app.tsx" switcher
143: import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
144: import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'
145: 
146: const geist = Geist({
147:   subsets: ['latin'],
148: })
149: 
150: export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
151:   return (
152:     <main className={geist.className}>
153:       <Component {...pageProps} />
154:     </main>
155:   )
156: }
157: ```
158: 
159: ```jsx filename="pages/_app.js" switcher
160: import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
161: 
162: const geist = Geist({
163:   subsets: ['latin'],
164: })
165: 
166: export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {

168:     <main className={geist.className}>
169:       <Component {...pageProps} />
170:     </main>
171:   )
172: }
173: ```
174: 
175: </PagesOnly>
176: 
177: We recommend using [variable fonts](https://fonts.google.com/variablefonts) for the best performance and flexibility. But if you can't use a variable font, you will need to specify a weight:
178: 
179: <AppOnly>

260: ## Local fonts
261: 
262: <AppOnly>
263: 
264: To use a local font, import the `localFont` function from `next/font/local` and specify the [`src`](/docs/app/api-reference/components/font#src) of your local font file. The path is resolved relative to the file where `localFont` is called. Fonts can be stored anywhere in the project, including the [`public`](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/public-folder) folder or co-located inside the `app` folder. For example, to use a font stored in `app/fonts/`:

271: })

parts.text:
Semua 12 fase selesai. Implementasi penuh desain Figma "mental health / High wireframe" di Next.js 16 dengan framer-motion selesai.

## Ringkasan Final

**Stack:** Next.js 16.2.12 (App Router, TS) + Tailwind v4 + framer-motion + lucide-react

**12 section terimplementasi (sesuai urutan Figma):**
| # | Section | Animasi kunci |
|---|---------|---------------|
| 1 | **Navbar** | Floating pill, fade-down, scroll shadow, mobile sheet |
| 2 | **Hero** | Video bg "breathing" zoom 18s, stagger fade-up, CTA hover |
| 3 | **Header** | Scroll reveal fade-up + stagger |
| 4 | **Features** | 4 kartu, scale-in stagger, hover lift + image zoom, icon pop |
| 5 | **How It Works** | 4 step, connecting line draw-on-scroll, numbered badges |
| 6 | **Statistic** | Count-up angka (10K+/500+/95%) saat in-view, divider |
| 7 | **Testimonial** | Carousel slide (7 kartu), autoplay 5s, dots sync, panah, responsive perView |
| 8 | **Pricing** | Toggle Monthly/Annually (AnimatePresence), glow pulse "Popular", hover lift |
| 9 | **About** | Parallax image reveal, text fade |
| 10 | **Gallery** | 2×4 grid, stagger reveal, hover zoom + overlay |
| 11 | **FAQ** | Accordion 6 item, height auto animasi, chevron rotate |
| 12 | **Footer** | Headline + link lists, avatar stack slide-in, social hover |

**Yang dikerjakan di sesi ini:**
- Perbaikan request Anda: "Live Better" satu baris dengan "Balance," + ganti bg hero ke video `hero-video-bg.webm`
- Lanjut Fase 2–11 (Header → Footer)
- Fix error saat verifikasi: `lucide-react` v1.28 hapus brand icons → buat SVG inline custom (Facebook/Instagram/X/Youtube), fix 2× `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` (useCountUp + Testimonial clamp), hapus unused imports

**Verifikasi:** lint ✓ (0 error/0 warning), build ✓ (static page ter-generate).

Jalankan `npm run dev` lalu buka `http://localhost:3000` untuk review keseluruhan. Beri tahu jika ada section yang perlu disesuaikan.

parts.text:
Saya sudah menganalisis lengkap struktur Figma vs implementasi saat ini. Berikut temuan dan rencana perbaikannya.

## Analisis Perbedaan

Saya menemukan **3 perbedaan utama** yang membuat tampilan kartu features "berbeda" dari Figma:

### 1. Layout grid asimetris (penyebab utama)
Implementasi saat ini: grid `sm:grid-cols-2` → semua 4 kartu **simetris** (lebar sama 50:50).

**Figma sebenarnya** (node #12:627, width 1280, height 1024):
- **Baris 1** (#12:628): Card kiri **fill lebar** (~845px) + Card kanan **fixed 410px** → asimetris ~2:1
- **Baris 2** (#12:647): Card kiri fill + Card kanan fill → simetris 1:1

Jadi Card 2 ("Guided Mindfulness") sengaja dibuat lebih sempit dari 3 kartu lainnya. Inilah yang membuat tiap kartu "terlihat berbeda".

### 2. Struktur konten kartu (overlay panel)
Saat ini: overlay gelap menutupi **seluruh kartu**, konten di `justify-end`.

**Figma** (template `EL-8e92daf4`):
- Kartu full-height (fill baris ~500px) dengan bg image penuh
- Konten berada di **panel overlay gelap 280px tinggi** (rgba(42,40,38,0.5)) di **bagian bawah**, konten **centered vertical** dalam panel
- Padding 48px, gap 32px
- Bg image terlihat bersih di ~220px bagian atas kartu

### 3. Tagline "Embrace Yourself" hilang
Figma (template `EL-3e8f8e77`): setiap card punya tagline kecil "Embrace Yourself" (font light) antara icon dan H3. Implementasi saat ini tidak ada.

### Struktur konten Figma per kartu (dalam panel 280px, centered):
```
[icon 48x48]
[tagline "Embrace Yourself" - light, kecil]
[H3 judul - Lora Medium 24px]
[body deskripsi - PJS Regular 16px]
```

## Rencana Perbaikan

File yang diubah: `components/sections/Features.tsx`

**A. Layout grid** — ganti dari `grid-cols-2` ke flex column berisi 2 baris:
- Baris 1: `flex-row gap-6` → Card1 `flex-1` (fill) + Card2 `w-[410px] shrink-0` (sempit)
- Baris 2: `flex-row gap-6` → Card3 `flex-1` + Card4 `flex-1`
- Tinggi baris: `h-[500px]` (atau responsif `h-[400px] md:h-[500px]`)
- Mobile: stack vertikal semua kartu sama lebar

**B. Struktur kartu** — pisahkan bg image (full) dari panel konten (280px bawah):
- Kartu: `relative overflow-hidden rounded-16px h-full`
- Bg image: `absolute inset-0 object-cover` (full card, tanpa overlay全局)
- Panel konten: `absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 h-[280px] bg-overlay-50 flex flex-col justify-center p-12 gap-8`
- Hover: image scale, panel opacity transition

**C. Konten panel** — tambahkan tagline + susun ulang:
```
icon (48x48, teal bg) 
tagline "Embrace Yourself" (text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-white/70)
H3 (Lora Medium 24px)
body (PJS Regular 16px)
```

**D. Responsif**:
- Desktop (lg+): layout asimetris Figma persis
- Tablet/mobile: semua kartu stack vertikal sama lebar, tinggi adaptif (`h-[420px]`)

**E. Animasi dipertahankan**: scale-in stagger, hover lift, image zoom, icon pop.

Sebelum saya eksekusi, satu pertanyaan klarifikasi:

Klarifikasi selesai. Rencana final disetujui: **asimetris 410px di desktop** untuk Card 2, mobile stack vertikal.

## Rencana Eksekusi Final

**File diubah:** `components/sections/Features.tsx` (rewrite penuh)

**Perubahan konkrit:**

1. **Layout grid → flex column 2 baris**
   - Baris 1: `flex gap-6` → Card1 `flex-1` + Card2 `basis-[410px] shrink-0` (asimetris)
   - Baris 2: `flex gap-6` → Card3 `flex-1` + Card4 `flex-1` (simetris)
   - Tinggi baris: `h-[400px] lg:h-[500px]`
   - Mobile (`<md`): `flex-col`, semua kartu sama lebar

2. **Struktur kartu: bg full + panel overlay 280px di bawah**
   - Kartu: `relative overflow-hidden rounded-[16px] h-full`
   - Bg image: `absolute inset-0` full card (tidak tertutup全局)
   - Panel konten: `absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-[280px] bg-overlay-50 flex flex-col justify-center p-8 lg:p-12 gap-8`

3. **Konten panel (centered vertical, sesuai Figma `justifyContent: center`)**
   ```
   [icon 48x48 teal]
   [tagline "Embrace Yourself" - text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-white/70]
   [H3 - Lora Medium 24px]
   [body - PJS Regular 16px]
   ```
   Tambah field `tagline: "Embrace Yourself"` di data `features`.

4. **Animasi dipertahankan**: scaleIn stagger, `whileHover y:-8`, image `group-hover:scale-110`, icon pop.

5. **Responsif**: overlay panel `h-[260px] lg:h-[280px]`, padding adaptif `p-8 lg:p-12`.

6. **Verifikasi**: `npm run lint` + `npm run build`.

Siap dieksekusi ketika Anda keluar dari plan mode. Beri sinyal "lanjut"/"eksekusi" untuk saya terapkan.

parts.text:
Saya sudah menganalisis Header section dan motion presets. Berikut rencana lengkapnya.

## Analisis

**Header.tsx saat ini:**
- Section punya hairline rule di **kanan** (line 21: `absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-px`)
- Konten (eyebrow + h2 + body) pakai `staggerContainer` + `fadeUp` (animasi dari bawah ke atas)
- Tidak ada garis di kiri konten

**Yang diminta:**
1. Garis lurus vertikal di **kiri konten**, jarak ~32px dari konten
2. Animasi **push dari kiri ke kanan** (slide horizontal), bukan fade-up

## Rencana Eksekusi

**File diubah:** `components/sections/Header.tsx`

### 1. Tambah garis vertikal di kiri konten

Sesuai Figma (section `header` #12:610 punya `strokes=neutral/Light strokeWeight="0px 1px 0px 0px"` = border kanan, tapi Anda minta yang kiri), saya tambahkan hairline rule di kiri blok konten dengan gap 32px.

Dua pendekatan layout:
- **A. Border-left pada motion.div konten** (line 29): `border-l border-white/15 pl-8` (pl-8 = 32px). Garis menempel di konten, paling simpel.
- **B. Absolute div terpisah** seperti hairline kanan: `<div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-X w-px bg-white/10" />`. Lebih fleksibel posisi.

Saya rekomendasi **A** (border-left + padding) karena lebih clean & responsive, garis ikut tinggi konten. Tapi kalau mau garis full-height section (dari atas sampai bawah section), pakai B.

Klarifikasi selesai. Berikut rencana final.

## Rencana Eksekusi Final

**File diubah:** `components/sections/Header.tsx` (2 perubahan)

### 1. Tambah garis kiri konten + padding 32px

**Lokasi:** Line 29, className motion.div konten

**Saat ini:**
```
className="flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-8"
```

**Menjadi:**
```
className="flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-8 border-l border-white/15 pl-8"
```
- `border-l border-white/15` → hairline vertikal 1px putih transparan
- `pl-8` → padding-left 32px, memberi jarak 32px antara garis dan konten

### 2. Animasi push kiri→kanan (slide horizontal)

**Pendekatan:** Buat variant baru `slideRight` di `lib/motion.ts`, lalu ganti `fadeUp` → `slideRight` di Header untuk ketiga elemen (eyebrow, h2, body).

**`lib/motion.ts` tambahan:**
```ts
export const slideRight: Variants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, x: -40 },
  visible: {
    opacity: 1,
    x: 0,
    transition: { duration: 0.7, ease: easeOutExpo },
  },
};
```
- `x: -40` → mulai 40px dari kiri posisi final
- `x: 0` → slide ke posisi asli (push kanan)
- stagger tetap pakai `staggerContainer` (anak-anak slide berurutan)

**`Header.tsx` perubahan import:**
```ts
import { slideRight, staggerContainer, viewportOnce } from "@/lib/motion";
```
Ganti `fadeUp` → `slideRight` di 3 tempat (eyebrow line 33, h2 line 41, body line 49).

### Yang tidak berubah
- Background image + overlay (line 10-18) — tetap
- Hairline kanan (line 21) — tetap
- `staggerContainer` + `viewportOnce` — tetap (urutan animasi tetap bertahap)

### Verifikasi
- `npm run lint` + `npm run build`

**Catatan teknis:** `prefers-reduced-motion` — `slideRight` pakai `x` transform. Framer-motion secara default menghormati reduced motion hanya jika dikonfigurasi eksplisit dengan `useReducedMotion`. Saat ini Header tidak pakai hook itu. Untuk konsistensi dengan Hero/Pricing yang sudah respect reduced motion, saya bisa tambahkan guard, tapi itu opsional.

Beri sinyal "eksekusi" untuk saya terapkan.

Saya sudah menganalisis struktur HowItWorks. Berikut temuan dan rencananya.

## Analisis

**Struktur saat ini** (HowItWorks.tsx):
- Line 55: kontainer utama `flex-col gap-20` → jarak antar blok (title → steps → CTA) semuanya **20px (5rem)**
- Line 84-105: blok "Steps" (grid 4 kolom)
- Line 107-117: blok "CTAs" (2 button)

**Masalah:** `gap-20` (80px) di kontainer utama membuat jarak antara steps dan CTA **sama** dengan jarak title→steps. Karena steps sudah dihapus description-nya (hanya icon + judul 2 baris), blok steps sekarang lebih pendek → secara visual jarak ke CTA terasa terlalu rapat/dekat.

## Rencana Eksekusi

**File diubah:** `components/sections/HowItWorks.tsx`

**Pendekatan:** Tambah margin-top khusus pada blok CTA untuk memperbesar jarak dari steps, tanpa mengubah gap global (agar title→steps tetap 80px).

Saat ini CTA pakai (line 108-113):
```
className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-4"
```

**Opsi perubahan:**

| Opsi | Perubahan | Jarak steps→CTA | Trade-off |
|------|-----------|-----------------|-----------|
| A | Tambah `mt-8` (32px) di CTA | 80 + 32 = 112px | Konsisten dengan pola lain |
| B | Tambah `mt-12` (48px) | 80 + 48 = 128px | Lebih lega |
| C | Tambah `mt-16` (64px) | 80 + 64 = 144px | Paling beda/jelas |
| D | Ganti kontainer `gap-20` → `gap-20` + CTA `mt-20` | 80 + 80 = 160px | Bisa terlalu jauh |

parts.text:
Ikon `Plus` dan `X` keduanya tersedia di lucide-react v1.28. Berikut analisis dan rencana lengkapnya.

## Analisis

**Faq.tsx saat ini:**
- Baris 5: import `ChevronDown` dari lucide-react
- Baris 139-145: ikon toggle — pakai satu `ChevronDown` yang di-`animate={{ rotate: 180 }}` saat terbuka (rotate animation)
- Baris 144: `<ChevronDown className="h-5 w-5" strokeWidth={2.2} />`

**Yang diminta:**
- Saat **tertutup/dropdown** (collapsed): tampilkan ikon `Plus` (+)
- Saat **terbuka** (expanded): tampilkan ikon `X` (×)
- Mengganti animasi rotate (chevron 180°) dengan **crossfade/swap** antara dua ikon berbeda

## Rencana Eksekusi

**File diubah:** `components/sections/Faq.tsx`

### 1. Perbarui import (baris 5)
```ts
import { Plus, X } from "lucide-react";
```
Hapus `ChevronDown`, tambah `Plus` + `X`.

### 2. Ganti blok ikon toggle (baris 139-145)

**Saat ini:**
```tsx
<motion.span
  animate={{ rotate: isOpen ? 180 : 0 }}
  transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: "easeOut" }}
  className="ml-auto flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15 text-white"
>
  <ChevronDown className="h-5 w-5" strokeWidth={2.2} />
</motion.span>
```

**Menjadi:**
```tsx
<motion.span
  className="ml-auto flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15 text-white"
>
  <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="wait">
    {isOpen ? (
      <motion.span
        key="x"
        initial={{ opacity: 0, rotate: -90 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, rotate: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, rotate: 90 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }}
      >
        <X className="h-5 w-5" strokeWidth={2.2} />
      </motion.span>
    ) : (
      <motion.span
        key="plus"
        initial={{ opacity: 0, rotate: 90 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, rotate: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, rotate: -90 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }}
      >
        <Plus className="h-5 w-5" strokeWidth={2.2} />
      </motion.span>
    )}
  </AnimatePresence>
</motion.span>
```

**Detail implementasi:**
- `AnimatePresence mode="wait"` — swap ikon dengan crossfade bersih (tunggu exit selesai sebelum enter)
- `Plus` muncul saat `!isOpen` (tertutup), `X` muncul saat `isOpen` (terbuka)
- Animasi: opacity 0→1 + rotate ±90°→0 untuk efek "pop" yang elegan
- Kontainer luar `motion.span` (bg bulat) tetap statis, tidak ikut rotate
- `h-5 w-5 strokeWidth 2.2` dipertahankan untuk konsistensi ukuran

### 3. Import `AnimatePresence`
Sudah ada di baris 4 (`import { motion, AnimatePresence }` — dipakai di konten accordion). Tidak perlu tambah import baru.

### Yang tidak berubah
- Struktur accordion (baris 128-164) — border, button, height animation konten
- Animasi konten `height: 0 → auto` (baris 149-160) — tetap
- Data FAQ, title, CTA — tetap
- Warna/ukuran ikon (`bg-white/15`, `text-white`, `h-8 w-8`) — tetap

### Verifikasi
- `npm run lint` + `npm run build`

**Catatan teknis:** Karena `AnimatePresence mode="wait"` menunggu ikon lama exit sebelum ikon baru masuk, ada jeda ~0.2s saat toggle. Ini sengaja agar swap terlihat halus (bukan abrupt). Jika mau instant tanpa jeda, ganti `mode="wait"` → `mode="sync"` (kedua ikon briefly overlap saat transition).

Berikut temuan lengkap dan rencana perbaikannya. ## Analisis Masalah Mobile ### Hero Section — 4 masalah: 1. **Headline terlalu besar di mobile** (line 61): `text-[2.75rem]` (44px) untuk layar <640px. "Find Calm Build Balance" dipaksa `whitespace-nowrap` (line 63) → overflow horizontal di layar sempit (~375px). String ~22 char × ~26px = ~572px > 375px. 2. **`
` disembunyikan di mobile** (line 64): `hidden sm:block` → di mobile "Live Better" menempel di baris yang sama dengan "Balance" tanpa break, tapi headline terlalu lebar → wrap acak. 3. **Section `min-h-[824px]`** (line 13): terlalu tinggi untuk mobile (~375×667). Konten sedikit, banyak ruang kosong. 4. **Padding vertikal berlebih** (line 43): `py-32` (128px) di mobile → konten mepet di tengah dengan ruang kosong besar. ### Features Section — 3 masalah: 5. **Card tinggi tetap `h-[420px]`** (line 92, 107) di mobile: 4 card × 420px + gap = ~1716px tinggi di mobile. Terlalu tinggi, bg image vs panel 280px ratio tidak optimal. 6. **Panel konten `h-[280px]`** (line 144) tetap di semua breakpoint: di card 420px, panel 280px = 67% kartu tertutup overlay. Di mobile sebaiknya panel lebih kecil agar bg image lebih terlihat. 7. **Section title `text-[2rem]`** (line 71): 32px untuk "Everything You Need to Support Your Mental Well-being" di mobile ~375px → wrap berantakan (mungkin OK, tapi borderline). ## Rencana Eksekusi **2 file diubah: `Hero.tsx` & `Features.tsx`** ### Hero.tsx (4 perbaikan) | # | Lokasi | Saat ini | Menjadi | Efek | |---|--------|----------|---------|------| | A1 | Line 13 | `min-h-[824px]` | `min-h-[600px] sm:min-h-[700px] lg:min-h-[824px]` | Tinggi adaptif per breakpoint | | A2 | Line 43 | `py-32 ... lg:py-40` | `py-20 sm:py-28 md:py-32 lg:py-40` | Padding vertikal lebih kecil di mobile | | A3 | Line 61 | `text-[2.75rem] ... sm:text-5xl md:text-[3.25rem] lg:text-[3.5rem]` | `text-[1.875rem] sm:text-[2.75rem] md:text-[3.25rem] lg:text-[3.5rem]` | Headline 30px di mobile (dari 44px) | | A4 | Line 63-65 | `whitespace-nowrap` + `
` | Hapus `whitespace-nowrap`, ganti `
` jadi `block sm:hidden` + tetap break | Headline wrap natural di mobile, "Live Better" tetap baris baru | ### Features.tsx (3 perbaikan) | # | Lokasi | Saat ini | Menjadi | Efek | |---|--------|----------|---------|------| | B1 | Line 92, 107 | `h-[420px] ... lg:h-[500px]` | `h-[340px] sm:h-[400px] lg:h-[500px]` | Card lebih pendek di mobile | | B2 | Line 144 | `h-[280px] ... p-8 lg:p-12` | `h-[200px] sm:h-[240px] lg:h-[280px] p-6 sm:p-8 lg:p-12` | Panel & padding adaptif | | B3 | Line 71 | `text-[2rem] ... sm:text-4xl ...` | `text-[1.625rem] sm:text-[2rem] md:text-[2.5rem] lg:text-[2.75rem]` | Section title 26px di mobile (dari 32px) | Satu klarifikasi sebelum finalisasi:

Klarifikasi selesai. Berikut rencana final yang siap dieksekusi.

## Rencana Eksekusi Final

**2 file diubah, total 7 edit kecil & terisolasi.**

### `components/sections/Hero.tsx` — 4 edit

| # | Lokasi | Perubahan |
|---|--------|-----------|
| A1 | Line 13 | `min-h-[824px]` → `min-h-[600px] sm:min-h-[700px] lg:min-h-[824px]` |
| A2 | Line 43 | `px-6 py-32 sm:px-10 md:px-12 lg:py-40` → `px-6 py-20 sm:px-10 sm:py-28 md:px-12 md:py-32 lg:py-40` |
| A3 | Line 61 | `text-[2.75rem] ... sm:text-5xl` → `text-[1.875rem] sm:text-[2.75rem] md:text-[3.25rem] lg:text-[3.5rem]` |
| A4 | Line 63-65 | Hapus `whitespace-nowrap` di kedua span, ganti `<br className="hidden sm:block">` → `<br className="block sm:hidden" />` + tambah `<br className="hidden sm:block" />` |

**Logika A4:** Di mobile, dua break (`block sm:hidden` + `hidden sm:block` = selalu break) → "Find Calm Build Balance" / "Live Better" 2 baris pasti. Desktop hanya 1 break (`hidden sm:block` aktif). Headline mobile kecil (30px) + natural wrap = tidak overflow.

### `components/sections/Features.tsx` — 3 edit

| # | Lokasi | Perubahan |
|---|--------|-----------|
| B1 | Line 92 & 107 | `h-[420px] ... lg:h-[500px]` → `h-[340px] sm:h-[400px] lg:h-[500px]` (di kedua baris) |
| B2 | Line 144 | `h-[280px] ... p-8 lg:p-12` → `h-[200px] sm:h-[240px] lg:h-[280px] p-6 sm:p-8 lg:p-12` |
| B3 | Line 71 | `text-[2rem] ... sm:text-4xl md:text-[2.5rem] lg:text-[2.75rem]` → `text-[1.625rem] sm:text-[2rem] md:text-[2.5rem] lg:text-[2.75rem]` |

### Yang tidak berubah
- Hero: video bg breathing, overlay, hairline kanan, divider "Calm & Peaceful" bawah, CTA pill, semua animasi stagger
- Features: layout asimetris desktop (410px Card 2), bg image per-card, overlay panel, icon transparent, gap 12px, animasi scaleIn/hover
- Konten/data semua tetap

### Breakpoint behavior (ringkasan)
- **Mobile (<640px):** Hero 600px tinggi, headline 30px 2-baris, card 340px+panel 200px, title 26px
- **Tablet (640-1024px):** Hero 700px, headline 44px, card 400px+panel 240px, title 32px
- **Desktop (1024px+):** Hero 824px, headline 56px, card 500px+panel 280px, title 44px — tidak berubah dari sebelumnya

### Verifikasi
- `npm run lint` + `npm run build`

Beri sinyal **"eksekusi"** untuk saya terapkan.
